title: The Survey of Stories
learning_focus: Survey purpose, personal/open-ended/interview/online forms, appropriate questions, audience, non-verbal cues, and summary.
story_premise: A town wants to know which stories residents wish to preserve, but the first survey asks leading and intrusive questions.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Survey purpose, personal/open-ended/interview/online forms, appropriate questions, audience, non-verbal cues, and summary.

areas.story: Define what the survey needs to learn and what it must not collect. Rewrite biased questions as neutral open-ended or multiple-choice items.
